blocks.text: Walnut Grove homes listed and sold, June to October 2026

Walnut Grove, October 2026. Detached houses: 38 listed at month end and 12 sold in October, a sales ratio of 32% (a sellers’ market). Condos and townhomes: 51 listed at month end and 17 sold in October, a sales ratio of 33% (a sellers’ market).

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal.

blocks.text: Looking across the period, Detached houses: 76 sold over 5 months against an average of 45.6 listed, about 3.0 months of listings at that pace; the busiest month was June with 21 sold. Condos and townhomes: 79 sold over 5 months against an average of 52.4 listed, about 3.3 months of listings at that pace; the busiest month was June with 18 sold.

Walnut Grove is the Township of Langley community between Highway 1 and the Fraser River, on the 200 Street / 208 Street / 88 Avenue grid.
200 Street runs the length of Langley from the US border (as Carvolth Road) north through Walnut Grove to the Golden Ears Bridge.
Derby Reach Regional Park at 21801 Allard Crescent is the Fraser riverfront park on Walnut Grove's north side.
Carvolth Exchange, the Township's largest transit hub, sits next to Highway 1 on 202 Street at the community's south edge.
Walnut Grove is a planned suburban mix of detached homes and strata townhouse clusters built around its schools and parks.
Walnut Grove Secondary School at 8919 Walnut Grove Drive describes itself as having an enrolment of almost 2,000 students, making it the largest school in Langley.
Metro Vancouver describes Derby Reach as a riverside park with the Fort-to-Fort Trail and the 38-site Edgewater Bar Campground.

blocks.text: Walnut Grove: rules that affect buyers

items.t: Township Zoning Bylaw No. 2500, as amended by the Small-Scale Multi-Unit Housing Bylaw No. 6020 (2024), now allows combinations of suites, accessory dwelling units and small multi-unit forms on eligible single-family lots.
That report states Bill 44 requires two to six units in restricted residential zones depending on lot and servicing, with Township zoning updated by June 30, 2024.

blocks.text: Walnut Grove: local details a buyer would not know

items.t: Carvolth Exchange opened December 1, 2012 with 14 bus bays, per transit records read.
SD35 notes its published catchment maps do not reflect Willoughby Slope catchment changes for 2027–2028, a warning that also signals boundaries are reviewed and can change.
Walnut Grove Secondary runs both English and French programs, per the school's own description.
The riverfront at Derby Reach is tidal Fraser shoreline, with park hours posted at entrances and gates locked at closing in regional parks generally.

blocks.text: Walnut Grove: development and new projects

items.t: Township capital projects include Fraser River dike widening and raising with status Planning, which touches the riverfront dike system north of Walnut Grove.
Walnut Grove homes pay Township flat-rate utilities where on the flat-rate system, billed separately from taxes.
The 2026 single-family flat rates are $779.96 water and $716.47 sewer; multi-family rates are $667.22 water and $609.00 sewer.
A secondary suite adds $233.99 water and $214.94 sewer in 2026.
Unpaid metered balances after the due date carry a 10% penalty, and metered bills go out three times a year.
Highway 1's 200 Street interchange and the Golden Ears Bridge via 200 Street are the community's freeway links.
TransLink's 555 Port Mann Express connects Carvolth Exchange to Lougheed Station, with increased Fall 2026 afternoon frequency toward Carvolth.
Local routes 562 (Langley Centre/Walnut Grove) and 595 (Langley Centre/Maple Meadows Station) serve Carvolth Exchange per transit records read.
The Fort-to-Fort Trail through Derby Reach gives a riverfront walking and cycling route toward Fort Langley.

blocks.text: Walnut Grove: risks and due diligence

items.t: Check the Township dike sheet and floodplain status for any lot north toward the Fraser.
The provincial dike inventory maps show pump stations, flood boxes, low dike sections and hazard-concern areas for the Township of Langley sheet (sheet 17).
Confirm suite legality under the current Zoning Bylaw No. 2500 as amended, since the 2024 SSMUH amendments changed unit counts on single-family lots.

faq.q: How does the 555 bus work for commuting?
faq.a: The 555 Port Mann Express runs between Carvolth Exchange and Lougheed Station over Highway 1 and the Port Mann Bridge. TransLink's Fall 2026 service changes add weekday afternoon trips toward Carvolth Exchange every 10 minutes from 3:30–4 p.m. and every 8 to 9 minutes from 4–6 p.m., shortening waits for the return commute to Langley.

faq.q: Which secondary school serves Walnut Grove?
faq.a: Walnut Grove Secondary School on Walnut Grove Drive is the community's secondary school. The school states it is located in Walnut Grove with almost 2,000 students, offers English and French academic studies, and is the largest school in Langley; SD35 still assigns catchments by exact address through its locator, so verify a specific home there.

Derby Reach Regional Park is the Fraser River park at 21801 Allard Crescent. Metro Vancouver lists it as a nature preserve and recreation park with hiking trails and scenic viewpoints, open 7 a.m. to 10 p.m.

faq.q: Are elementary catchments fixed across Walnut Grove?
faq.a: No, they vary by street across the community's several elementary schools. SD35 publishes individual catchment maps for schools including Alex Hope, Dorothy Peacock, Topham and West Langley elementaries and for Walnut Grove Secondary, and directs families to its School Locator Tool or the board office at 604-534-7891 if unsure.
